text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Work dragged on, and night had fallen. I 
need to eat something, but the cafeteria 
is already closed at this hour."
choice_data_list:
(I'm pretty sure there was some cup ramen 
around here...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, you planning to push through today 
with that too?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo. Working hard late into the night, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna push yourself that hard, 
you'd better eat properly to make up for 
it. So with that said—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Here ya go, hup.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Here's a little treat from me! Eat this 
and get some energy in ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she handed me was a roughly sliced 
piece of pumpkin. It seemed to be steamed, 
piping hot steam rising from it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
They're just steamed, but man, they taste 
incredible while they're hot, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Popping the pumpkin into my mouth and 
taking a big bite—the gentle sweetness and 
steaming, tender texture filled both body 
and soul."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Right? I raised 'em with all my 
love and care. So I can guarantee they're 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Working the field is good exercise, and 
eating the harvested vegetables provides 
good nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Get healthy, eat delicious food, and it 
doesn't cost a dime. Heh, talk about 
killing three birds with one stone!
choice_data_list:
(That's such a healthy way of looking at 
things.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I found myself admiring the 
way she carried herself. Never getting 
ahead of herself, keeping her feet firmly 
on the ground—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Step by step, with steady progress, she is 
heading toward a grand dream. Seeing her 
like that made her look so dependable and 
cool.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If only I could become like her...
choice_data_list: Can I help out with the fieldwork again?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this? Getting motivated now, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you're more than welcome! 
...Ah, but first you eat and sleep! Field 
work comes after that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's get started, then!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, is there any vegetable you 
want to plant? Oh, fruit sounds pretty 
good too~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was brainstorming what crops to 
grow together with Katsuragi Ace—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Impressive! So you too wish to grow new 
crops, do you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Chairwoman! ...When you say "you guys 
too," does that mean you're planning on 
planting something new, Chairwoman?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! I wish to increase crop 
varieties and achieve further growth!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh, that sounds great—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I know! Then how about teaming up with us?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing the Chairwoman, wouldn't she have 
prepared all sorts of seeds and seedlings 
for us?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I've prepared plenty of seeds 
and saplings! I couldn't ask for more if 
you're willing to help!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Then it's settled! Heheh, looks like I'll 
get to grow all sorts of things. I can't 
wait."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, as everyone was sowing seeds and 
planting seedlings—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hm? This is—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh, a fig tree sapling, huh~? Sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it takes about two years to harvest, 
so you don't get many chances to grow it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Looks like this'll be a new challenge! 
Alright, Trainer, let's try planting this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we planted an assortment of 
vegetables and fig saplings. I can't wait 
to see them grow!
